title: Weak convergence with local mass bounds implies convergence on continuous forms
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ (S : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U n) (S₀ : GeometricCurrentOn U n), (∀ W, CompactlyContainedOpen W U → (⨆ q, (S q).massOn W) < ∞) → WeaklyConvergesOn S S₀ → ∀ ω : Eucl P → Covector (Eucl P) n, Continuous ω → HasCompactSupport ω → tsupport ω ⊆ U → ∀ (μ : ℕ → Measure (Eucl P)) (v : ℕ → Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n) (μ₀ : Measure (Eucl P)) (v₀ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n), (∀ q, IsMeasureRepresentation (S q) (μ q) (v q)) → IsMeasureRepresentation S₀ μ₀ v₀ → Tendsto (fun q => ∫ x, v q x (ω x) ∂(μ q)) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, v₀ x (ω x) ∂μ₀))
